title: corallodiscus lanuginosus
intro: Corallodiscus lanuginosus, commonly known as the hairy bellflower, is a plant species native to the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Corallodiscus lanuginosus include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
